tagline: Texas Hold'em. Host is the dealer. Invite is the seats.
description:
A felt table, a 52-card shoe, toy chips. Two hole cards, then the flop, the turn, the river. Fold, check, call, or raise. Best five of seven takes the pot.

On your own, two bots sit across from you. Press Play with friends, then Invite in the bar above the app: everyone who opens the link takes a seat. The host deals. There is no account, no lobby code, and no game server.

Chips are toys. Nothing is wagered and nothing is paid out. Card faces are generic ranks and suits.

An unofficial port of Vintage Poker by Patrick Obermeier. The original is a React site on Node, Express and socket.io. This copy is not.
